fieldValues.title: D4. Decide: the right owner for the level
fieldValues.thinking_reached: The ideal: the owner of the level where the decision removes choices settles it, by mode and door (decision 949ae72d), so the programme owner sees strategy and a group sees its own technical choices. What happens: technical ADR choices reach the owner's session (01cfb06e; srs-rust#1470 asked the owner to merge an ADR text fix).
fieldValues.tensions: Owner sees everything, and each level decides its own.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: How many owner asks were below the owner's level?
fieldValues.next_action: Count decisions that reached the owner from a lower level as decision-stop findings here.
